origins.neoorigins.class_warrior.name: dike
origins.neoorigins.class_warrior.descrip: Ọkachamara ọgụ nke na-akụsi ike ma kwụsie ike megide ịkụ azụ.
power.neoorigins.class_warrior_battle_st: +2 ihe agha eke - ịdị jụụ nke onye agha na-atụgharị obere ihe.
power.neoorigins.class_warrior_endurance: + 1 obi (+2 max HP) sitere na ọnya agha meriri.
power.neoorigins.class_warrior_iron_will: Na-egbochi adịghị ike - ọ dịghị onye na-emebi ike gị.
origins.neoorigins.class_archer.name: Onye na-agba ụta
origins.neoorigins.class_archer.descript: Ọkachamara dị iche iche nwere ebumnuche zuru oke yana ọrụ ụkwụ mara mma.
power.neoorigins.class_archer_accuracy.d: All projectiles na-efe efe n'ụzọ zuru oke - enweghị mgbasa ozi enweghị usoro.
power.neoorigins.class_archer_agility.de: Na-eme 15% ngwa ngwa karịa ka nkịtị.
power.neoorigins.class_archer_hawk_eye.d: Na-ahụ n'ụzọ doro anya na obere ìhè - onyinye dinta.
power.neoorigins.class_archer_arthropod_: Ọkụ na spiders na arthropods ndị ọzọ na-ebelata ha maka sekọnd 2.
power.neoorigins.class_archer_starting_a: Jiri akụ akụ nke nwere akụ iri na isii wụsara.
origins.neoorigins.class_miner.name: Onye na-egwuputa ihe
origins.neoorigins.class_miner.descripti: Onye ọkachamara na-egwupụta ihe nke na-agbaji ngwa ngwa ma na-egwupụta ogbunigwe n'enweghị ike ọgwụgwụ.
power.neoorigins.class_miner_speed.name: Ọkachamara Ngwuputa Ngwuputa
Na-eji 30% obere agụụ mgbe ọ na-egwupụta akụ ma na-eme nchọpụta.
power.neoorigins.class_miner_stone_fists: Aka efu na-agbaji okwute dị ka okwute pickaxe.
Na-ahụ n'ụzọ doro anya na ọchịchịrị - afọ n'okpuruala nkọ anya.
+1 obi (+2 max HP) sitere na okpokolo agba nke onye na-egwuputa ihe siri ike.
origins.neoorigins.class_beastmaster.des: Anụ anụ anụ nke anụ ụlọ na-ekekọrịta mmetụta potion gị yana ọgwụ ike ya na-adịte aka.
power.neoorigins.class_beastmaster_diffu: A na-ekekọrịta mmetụta ọgwụ ike ị nwetara n'etiti anụmanụ ndị a zụrụ azụ.
power.neoorigins.class_beastmaster_potio: Mmetụta potion niile na-adịru 50% ogologo oge.
origins.neoorigins.class_explorer.name: Onye nchọgharị
origins.neoorigins.class_explorer.descri: Onye njem nwere ahụmahụ nke na-amalite nke ọma maka njem na-adịghị ahụkebe.
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_kit.name: Malite kompas
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_kit.desc: Jiri kompas tinye n'ime ngwa ahịa gị.
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_clock.de: Jiri elekere dị na ngwa ahịa gị wụpụ.
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_maps.des: Jiri maapụ 9 efu dị na ngwa ahịa gị.
Na-eji 40% obere agụụ site na mmemme niile.
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_sure_foo: Ọ dịghị emebi ọdịda ọdịda - ụzọ ahụ na-akụzi ebe ọ ga-ada.
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_climbers: Na-arị elu ngọngọ zuru ezu na-awụlighị elu.
power.neoorigins.step_assist_switch.name: Nyere aka
power.neoorigins.step_assist_switch.desc: Na-agbanye ike mgbake gị ma gbanyụọ. Gbanyụọ pụtara na ị na-arịgoro ngọngọ site na ịwụli elu, dịka onye ọ bụla ọzọ.
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_campfire: Ji nwayọọ nwayọọ na-emegharị mgbe n'ime 5 blocks nke ọ bụla campfire - naanị mgbe ọgụ (5 sekọnd kemgbe kụrụ ikpeazụ).
origins.neoorigins.class_sentinel.name: Sentinel
origins.neoorigins.class_sentinel.descri: Ọkachamara nchekwa nke nwere ngwa agha eke, ogwu na ụkwụ na-enweghị mgbagha.
power.neoorigins.class_sentinel_thorns.d: Na-eweghachi 25% nke mmebi nke ndị mwakpo nwetara.
power.neoorigins.class_sentinel_knockbac: 40% knockback eguzogide - sentinels guzo n'ala ha.
power.neoorigins.class_sentinel_iron_wil: Na-egbochi adịghị ike na ịdị nwayọọ.
power.neoorigins.class_sentinel_guard_en: +1 obi (+2 max HP) sitere na elekere na-adịghị agwụ agwụ.
power.neoorigins.class_sentinel_guard_st: +35% agbakwunyere nkwụghachi azụ mgbe ị na-amị amị (75% mkpokọta) - kwado ahịrị ahụ.
origins.neoorigins.class_herbalist.name: Ogwu ogwu
origins.neoorigins.class_herbalist.descr: Isi mkpịsị akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ nke na-eme ka ihe ọkụkụ dị ngwa ngwa, na-amịpụta mkpụrụ ego, ma na-eguzogide nsị.
Ihe ọkụkụ dị nso na-eto ngwa ngwa n'ihu gị.
power.neoorigins.class_herbalist_harvest: Ihe ọkụkụ na-amịpụta 50% karịa mgbe owuwe ihe ubi.
power.neoorigins.class_herbalist_green_t: Ngwa nri ọkpụkpụ na-eto eto ọzọ.
power.neoorigins.class_herbalist_startin: Jiri mkpụrụ ọka kụnye ka ọ malite ubi gị.
Spawn na ntụtụ nke nri ọkpụkpụ.
origins.neoorigins.class_scout.name: Scout
origins.neoorigins.class_scout.descripti: Onye nchọ ụzọ nwere anya nke ọma nwere ọhụụ abalị, mmegharị ngwa ngwa, yana nzọ ụkwụ siri ike.
power.neoorigins.class_scout_night_visio: Enwere ike ịhụ nke ọma n'ọchịchịrị. Jiri igodo ọhụụ abalị tụgharịa (nke ndabara K).
power.neoorigins.class_scout_speed.name: Ije ngwa ngwa
power.neoorigins.class_scout_speed.descr: Na-eme 20% ngwa ngwa karịa ka nkịtị.
power.neoorigins.class_scout_trackers_st: Na-arị elu ngọngọ zuru ezu na-awụlighị elu.
power.neoorigins.class_scout_trail_ratio: Spawn na otu ogbe achịcha maka okporo ụzọ.
origins.neoorigins.class_berserker.name: Ọkachamara
origins.neoorigins.class_berserker.descr: Onye agha nwere nkụda mmụọ nke na-azụ ahịa agụụ maka ike ọkụ na-emebi emebi.
Agụụ na-agụ 50% ngwa ngwa - ọnụma na-ere ike.
power.neoorigins.class_berserker_rage_wi: +2 mmebi ọgụ mgbe ọ dị ma ọ bụ na-erughị ọkara ahụike.
power.neoorigins.class_berserker_thick_s: + 20% nkwụghachi azụ - onye na-eme ihe na-esikarị ike ịmalite.
origins.neoorigins.class_titan.name: Titan
origins.neoorigins.class_titan.descripti: Ahịhịa dị elu nke nwere ahụike ọzọ, agbatị agbatị, na nnukwu oke.
power.neoorigins.class_titan_size.name: Na-amanye
power.neoorigins.class_titan_size.descri: 25% buru ibu karịa onye ọkpụkpọ nkịtị.
power.neoorigins.class_titan_health.name: Oke-akpụkpọ anụ
power.neoorigins.class_titan_reach.name: Ogologo ogwe aka
power.neoorigins.class_titan_reach.descr: Nwere ike imekọrịta ihe na ụlọ ọrụ site n'ebe ọzọ.
power.neoorigins.class_titan_crushing_gr: +1 mmebi ọgụ - aka dị ka nkume.
power.neoorigins.class_titan_unmoving.de: + 20% nkwụghachi azụ - titan anaghị asụ ngọngọ.
power.neoorigins.class_titan_heavy_steps: Na-eji nwayọ nwayọ 10% - nnukwu ụdị a na-adọkpụ n'ụzọ.
origins.neoorigins.class_rogue.name: Rogue
origins.neoorigins.class_rogue.descripti: Onye ogbu mmadụ zoro ezo nke na-atụgharị na-adịghị ahụ anya mgbe ọ na-ezoro ezo ma na-emebi mmebi azụ azụ.
power.neoorigins.class_rogue_sneaky.name: Ọnụnọ zoro ezo
power.neoorigins.class_rogue_sneaky.desc: A naghị ahụ efere aha gị site na mgbidi ma ndị na-eme mkpọtụ na-enwe oge siri ike ịchọta gị.
power.neoorigins.class_rogue_stealth.des: Mgbe sneaking maka 10 sekọnd, bụrụ-adịghị ahụ anya. Mwakpo sitere n'azụ na-emebi mmebi 2x.
power.neoorigins.class_rogue_parkour.des: Na-arị elu ngọngọ zuru ezu na-awụlighị elu.
power.neoorigins.class_rogue_backstab.de: +2 mmebi ọgụ mgbe ị na-ezoro ezo.
origins.neoorigins.class_lumberjack.name: Onye na-agba osisi
origins.neoorigins.class_lumberjack.desc: Ọkachamara onye na-akụ osisi nke ji otu ntu were kwatuo osisi niile wee rụpụta osisi n'osisi.
power.neoorigins.class_lumberjack_tree_f: Iji anyụike na-agbaji osisi na-akụda osisi ahụ dum otu mgbe.
power.neoorigins.class_lumberjack_bonus_: Ịme osisi site na osisi na-emepụta planks 2 ọzọ.
power.neoorigins.class_lumberjack_axe_ha: Aka efu na-egbutu osisi dị ka anyụike ígwè.
